t: This 4lite rectangular LED bulkhead provides reliable emergency lighting for commercial environments. It offers maintained or non-maintained operation with a 3-hour emergency run time, making it suitable for workshops, corridors, and stairwells. The robust polycarbonate body and diffuser ensure durability, while the IP65 rating allows for both indoor and outdoor installation. Delivering 167 lumens of 6500K daylight illumination, this 3.5W unit features multiple cable entries for flexible fitting and a long 36,000-hour life. Fixings are supplied for straightforward ceiling or wall-mounting.
b: 5 Year Manufacturer’s Guarantee (Registration Required, T&Cs Apply)
